ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution toward low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity white and orange clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black mapping across both lobes. A distinct white/light gray patch is localized on the lower interior portion of the right lobe. Orange/brown high-contrast pixel clusters are mapped exclusively to the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a wide-angle pixel convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, rhythmic serrations. The right lobe distal edge shows high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness corresponding to surface epibiota.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the leading edges sweeping laterally and dorsally; the left trailing edge follows a generally straight to slightly concave trajectory toward the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed orange and tan circular pixel clusters localized at the far right distal tip, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured epibiotic mass (barnacle colony) protruding from the distal margin of the right fluke lobe.
